search_terms: Task14 natural QK branch number specificity
fronted self score same number noun control

closest_prior_work.relation: Showed that both QK branches compose the self-score effect, but its individual q/k hybrid corners break the natural shared-residual tie and it did not test number specificity.
Used same-number noun controls for the projected value, not the self-score or either complete QK branch.

novelty: First matched specificity test of the fronted self score and its two complete natural QK branch scalars. For each recipient, a frozen foreign group supplies a same-number A1 base donor and opposite-number A1 donor; those two donor prompts are identical except at final subject token 8. Within each branch q and k come from the same natural donor residual. With opposite-number donor u8 fixed and non-self terms native, compare recipient, same-number, and opposite-number branch scores using task margin and CE.

registered_screens.joint_natural_score_number_specificity: the tied opposite-number joint score is live in both direction cells, has the known cell-specific correction sign with at least 75 percent row agreement, and the absolute same-number joint effect is at most 25 percent of the opposite-number effect in every cell; CE supports the opposite-number sign
registered_screens.qk1_natural_score_number_specificity: the opposite-number QK1-only arm is at least 20 percent of the opposite-number joint effect with at least 75 percent row sign agreement in both cells, and same-number QK1 leakage is at most 25 percent of that opposite-number QK1 effect in every cell
registered_screens.qk2_natural_score_number_specificity: independently apply the same liveness, row-sign, and same-number-leakage tests to the complete natural QK2 scalar

required_controls: frozen cyclic foreign-group pairing within recipient subject number and both attractor plurality states
same-number and opposite-number donor prompts differ only at final subject token 8 and both use a foreign noun/context relative to the recipient
within each natural branch q and k or q2 and k2 come from the same captured donor residual
opposite-number donor u8 is identical in every intervention arm and all non-self source terms remain native
same-number and opposite-number recipient-score baselines are identical
direct branch dot products and p=a times b exactly reproduce captured natural scores
native capability, finite live opposite-number joint correction, exact replay and source-term identities
report every cell and deterministic lexical half; do not select interactions
interpretation_limits: The joint same/opp score comparison is a tied natural-state counterfactual. Single-branch arms still mix one donor branch scalar with the recipient's other branch and are branch-level characterization.
This tests grammatical-number specificity against matched foreign-noun/context controls; it does not prove syntax-general semantics.
OOD text is reused; pristine OOD, individual query/key semantics, selectivity, and completeness remain closed.
